description: Jiangxi University of Science and Technology and Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers map built-up land in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei during 2000–2020. Landsat-based estimates are combined with GlobeLand30, GHS-Built, GAIA and GLC_FCS products. ScienceDB lists a ZIP of built-up maps and an XLSX workbook of city-level land-consumption, population-growth and SDG 11.3.1 ratios under CC BY 4.0. These freely reusable outputs can initialise urban-expansion and infrastructure-demand simulations. Reported overall map accuracy exceeds 90 percent, but local classification uncertainty remains. Built-up area does not directly give building functions, network capacities or service quality. Population and land-consumption ratios also depend on the stated boundaries. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: A dataset of urban built-up area and SDG 11.3.1 indicators for the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, China from 2000 to 2020
notes: G4-0155; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
